description: Prove the integration works: send a test click, lead and sale through Affitor's real attribution pipeline, recorded as is_test rows that are never paid. Use it after setup, then poll affitor_readiness until integration_verified is true. Limited to 10 runs per program per hour; on rate_limited, wait retry_after_seconds. Returns the API response, with http_status added on an error.
name: affitor_run_verification
